channel.title: Möllerhatté — Horror & Speculative Fiction
channel.description: New horror and speculative fiction stories by Galman Ferguson.

item.title: THE VISITOR
item.description: A man recovering from a difficult night begins to notice something deeply wrong inside his apartment.

item.title: MEMORY OF THE SAVANNAH
item.description: A late-night drive along a notorious highway takes a disturbing turn when a stranded couple offers a glimpse into something that should have remained forgotten.

item.title: The Red Lady of Wyrmhill
item.description: A strange encounter on a lonely road leads to a disturbing discovery buried in the history of Wyrmhill.

item.title: BON APPÉTIT!
item.description: A seemingly ordinary meal takes a dark and unexpected turn.

item.title: Blind Date
item.description: A blind date takes an unsettling turn.

item.title: Age Is Just a Number
item.description: Some things are not quite what they seem when it comes to age.

item.title: The Cornfield
item.description: A seemingly ordinary cornfield hides something deeply disturbing.

item.title: Beyond The Ridge
item.description: Beyond the ridge lies something that should never have been found.

item.title: The Wishing Well Of Heathenberry Forest
item.description: A wishing well hidden deep in the forest holds a terrible secret.

item.title: Necrophobia
item.description: A fear of the dead becomes something much more disturbing.

item.title: The Taxi Fare
item.description: One late-night taxi ride comes with a fare that no passenger could have expected.

item.title: Into the Mangrove Forest
item.description: A journey into a mangrove forest becomes a descent into something ancient and terrifying.
